From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
[Futebol Clube do Porto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FC_Porto "FC Porto") is a Portuguese [sports club](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sports_club "Sports club") based in [Porto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porto "Porto") that is best known for its professional [association football](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Association_football "Association football") team competing in the country's top-tier division, the [Primeira Liga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Primeira_Liga "Primeira Liga"). The club was founded on 28 September 1893 by [António Nicolau de Almeida](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ant%C3%B3nio_Nicolau_de_Almeida "António Nicolau de Almeida"), its first president, and since then has had a total of 31 distinct presidents, some of which have held office in multiple occasions.
As of 7 May 2024, the current and 32nd president is [former club manager](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_FC_Porto_managers "List of FC Porto managers") [André Villas-Boas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andr%C3%A9_Villas-Boas "André Villas-Boas"). He succeeded [Jorge Nuno Pinto da Costa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jorge_Nuno_Pinto_da_Costa "Jorge Nuno Pinto da Costa"), the club's longest-serving chairman, in office for 42 consecutive years since 1982.
